paragraphs: R' Yose, son of R' Yaakov bar Idi.
Mentioned in Bereshit Rabbah 98:17 and Midrash Tehillim 81:4, reporting in the name of R' Acha.[^1][^2][^3]

notes.text: Supplied father-name Idi differs from earlier provisional audit Acha. Both layers remain distinct, and the source heading is not repaired or identity-bound.
ב״ר פ״צח־יז and מד׳ תהלים פפ״א־ד are read as Bereshit Rabbah 98:17 and Midrash Tehillim 81:4, with exact labels retained here rather than claiming verified edition mapping.

The text explicitly says in-Acha’s-name: the older note’s does-not-say-whose-name claim is corrected. Only the reporter is understood from the heading and the teaching content unstated. All three title abbreviations remain R'.
